taxonomic_note: Current Kew accepts Grindelia nuda; Grindelia squarrosa var. nuda is a homotypic synonym.
look_here_first: Start with the head: curlytop gumweed is typically rayless, with only yellow disc florets surrounded by many narrow spreading to ascending resin-gland-tipped phyllaries. Vegetative parts are strongly gland-dotted and aromatic.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays — Natural Purola flora lists Grindelia nuda var. nuda as naturally occurring. Williamson — county flora documents Grindelia squarrosa var. nuda, a synonym of current Grindelia nuda. Burnet — detailed county treatment documents the same synonym/current concept.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Historic var. nuda records are counted only after explicit synonym reconciliation to current Grindelia nuda.

best_field_traits: glabrous to nearly glabrous gland-dotted shoots
many narrow spreading to ascending phyllaries with resinous tips
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Rayless yellow head + gland-dotted aromatic foliage + narrow spreading resin-tipped phyllaries is the strongest field package.
